rdf:Description.rdfs:label: ask
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Optional read-only SPARQL ASK existence preflight, evaluated before otc:target SELECT.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Transcoder
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A survey-based transformation rule set for turning NL into structured LOD via LLM.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Transcoder Rule
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The basic unit: an AIML-inspired pairing of an NL survey question and an RDF template payload.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: target
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A read-only SPARQL SELECT query that projects RDF resources and values to be interpreted by the survey. The executor selects the source graph/dataset for each stage.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: query
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The survey question posed to the LLM densely packed with RDF schema entities.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: assume
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A plain-language background assumption required for the survey rule.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: template
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The RDF/Turtle template using conditional logic for entity URI vs literal fallback.

rdf:Description.dcterms:title: ChatGPT Conversation Topic Extractor
rdf:Description.dcterms:description: Surveys conversation text to extract core topics using dense LOD entity patterns.

rdf:Description.otc:assume: The selected source dataset contains populated schema:Conversation and schema:Message nodes; the SPARQL target determines the candidate rows.
The target message has an author role of 'assistant'.
rdf:Description.otc:query: What is the primary schema:Thing the bot reply is schema:about within the schema:hasPart > schema:Message identified by dcterms:identifier ?msg_id of the schema:Conversation identified by dcterms:identifier ?conv_id?

rdf:Description.dcterms:title: ChatGPT User Sentiment Extractor
rdf:Description.dcterms:description: Evaluates the user prompt in a message turn to extract overall sentiment (e.g., Positive, Neutral, Negative, Frustrated, Curious).

rdf:Description.otc:assume: The selected source dataset contains populated schema:Conversation and schema:Message nodes; the SPARQL target determines the candidate rows.
The target prompt message has an author role of 'user'.
rdf:Description.otc:query: What is the primary sentiment expressed by the user in the schema:Message identified by dcterms:identifier ?msg_id within the schema:Conversation identified by dcterms:identifier ?conv_id?

rdf:Description.dcterms:title: ChatGPT Bot Response Mode Extractor
rdf:Description.dcterms:description: Determines the communicative mode of the bot answer (asking a question, providing instructions, providing code/example, or direct compliance).

rdf:Description.otc:assume: The selected source dataset contains populated schema:Conversation and schema:Message nodes; the SPARQL target determines the candidate rows.
The target message has an author role of 'assistant'.
rdf:Description.otc:query: What is the communicative mode of the bot reply in the schema:Message identified by dcterms:identifier ?msg_id of the schema:Conversation identified by dcterms:identifier ?conv_id (e.g., 'question', 'instructions', 'example', or 'direct compliance')?

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: validator
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SHACL node shape whose focus node is the ?message IRI from each otc:target row. Every selected focus node must conform before the LLM survey is invoked.
